title: When the Hollow Wakes Anew
author: Ada Dravenmoor
blurb: Cyrus Amberdale, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
